propositions: Five fixture builders repeatedly construct equivalent git-backed rebar store topologies from scratch for every consumer despite invariant post-setup state, contributing 103.416 worker-seconds across the top five test modules in Verify run 31846417650.

Focused runtime measurements show real store construction takes 0.426-1.445s versus 0.031-0.126s for isolated copies, yielding 12x-23.7x speedup per copy while maintaining independent ticket IDs, worktree refs, and environment identity.

The clone_topology_template helper omitted .opcert-key/.pub reminting, causing all per-test copies to share private signing authority despite distinct environment principals, violating the isolation contract.

Merged commit 3bf9b2b2c4 migrated only proven-equivalent fixtures to session-scoped templates with per-test isolated copies, preserved all from-scratch initialization/recovery tests, added isolation sentinels for half-rewritten pointers and shared state, and eliminated the targeted >1s fixture_setup spans without removing or weakening any assertions.
